verdicts.evidence: lines 460, 491-496, 600-602, 626, 672-675, 708: Try again, Dismiss, Remove, Send invite, Keep on team, Remove from team and Save name all have listeners that call the api or open/close the dialog and update the view.

lines 462-478: name, member rows, seat count and notification boxes are all built from api.getTeam(); line 316 gives an empty message; line 543 shows 'Never' for a null lastActive. No hardcoded sample values in the markup.
lines 665-667: the remove confirmation is the only dependent step and its title names the member and the team ('Remove X from Y?'), with the consequence at line 344.
lines 283-295, 321-332: each task is a one or two field single-step form (email plus role, or one name field) with no long free text; role and notification changes save at once.
lines 289-290: invite role preselects Member, the lower privilege, and is reset to member at 649. Lines 669-670: dialog focus goes to 'Keep on team'; the dialog has no form, so Enter does not remove.
Brief lists six occasional tasks of equal standing (rename, view, invite, change role, remove, notifications); lines 275-338 give each its own section, so no single dominant frequent task.

lines 275-338: sections are Members (invite form, table, remove), Team name, Email notifications, all named in the brief. Seat count (472) and Last active (606) are member fields from the server shown inside the member list, not added sections or widgets.

line 292: 'Send invite' is the only .btn.primary on the page; 'Save name' (326), row 'Remove' (600), 'Try again'/'Dismiss' (491-492) are plain .btn. Dialog (347-348) has one plain and one filled button.

lines 119, 347-349: in the remove dialog 'Remove from team' is the only filled, high-contrast button (.btn.danger, solid background) beside a plain outlined 'Keep on team', so the destructive action carries the prominent style. It is not the Enter default (670).
lines 426-429: aria-disabled is set only while a request is in flight. Owner row omits the role select and Remove (573-575). When seats are full the reason is text under the invite form (475-479).
line 554: the only tooltip is a title on the last-active time giving the exact date and time; the cell already shows the relative or short date as text (549-553).
lines 264-352 and all strings in the script (449, 479, 592, 636-656, 685, 696, 716-728, 746): no visible text mentions the build, framework, request, mock data or unfinished features.

line 344: 'They lose access at once. You can invite them again later.' sits in the remove dialog at the decision. Line 479: the seats-full note sits under the invite form it blocks. No other notes or callouts.
lines 264-352: headings and labels only. The one descriptive sentence is the empty-state line 'People you invite appear here.' (316), which says what would appear, not how to use controls.
lines 277-278, 282, 320-322, 343-344: no heading has a restating subtitle and no field has helper text; the dialog description adds the consequence and does not repeat the title.
lines 264, 277, 282, 320, 336, 650, 696, 725: plain headings ('Team settings', 'Members') and messages naming the person or email; no greeting, slogan, superlative or exclamatory sentence.

lines 270, 293, 327, 347, 349, 491-492, 600: 'Try again', 'Send invite', 'Save name', 'Keep on team', 'Remove from team', 'Dismiss', and 'Remove' inside each member row (aria-label names the person). No OK/Submit/Yes/No.

lines 405-413: role and notification keys are mapped to 'Owner', 'Admin', 'Member', 'Weekly digest' etc., with a tidy() fallback that strips underscores. Null lastActive shows 'Never' (543). No ids or codes are rendered.

lines 424, 449, 592, 636-638, 653-656, 685, 728: errors name the problem and next step ('Could not send the invite to X. The connection dropped. Try again.'); e.message and codes are never shown, only mapped by e.code.

lines 449, 592, 636-638, 656, 685, 716, 728, 746: wording is 'Could not ...' or 'Enter ...', with no 'invalid', 'failed', 'oops' or capitals. The '! ' at line 127 is a CSS marker glyph before the text, not exclamatory wording.

lines 316, 473-474: with zero members the table is hidden and 'No one is on this team yet. People you invite appear here.' shows, directly below the always-visible invite form (281-295) that is the next step.
No filter or search. Load failure shows 'Could not load team settings.' with 'Try again' in the load area (447-452); no members shows the separate empty line under the invite form (316, 473).

lines 447-452: load failure text plus retry. 651-656, 726-728: invite and name failures show a message and keep the typed value. 521-527, 490-501: role and notification failures show an in-row error with Try again. 684-686: remove failure stays in the dialog.

lines 267, 443: spinner and 'Loading team settings' on load. 426-429, 293, 327, 349: buttons swap to busy labels at once. 511: 'Saving' with spinner for role and notification changes. Calls are at most 1.5 s.

lines 274, 316, 455-457: #content and the empty message are hidden until getTeam resolves and render() runs; seat count is empty until renderCount (472). Only the loading status shows during the wait.

line 181: name and email wrap with overflow-wrap:anywhere; 257: dialog title wraps; 543-545: null or bad lastActive gives 'Never' or 'Unknown'; 412-413: unknown roles get a tidy label; rows are a plain growing table (465).
lines 755-758: beforeunload calls preventDefault when the team name differs from the saved one or the invite email is non-empty, so the browser asks before leaving; no prompt when nothing is changed.
line 284: the only format-bound field is labelled 'Email address' with type=email (285), which states the expected format before typing; the team name has no format rule beyond being non-empty.
lines 283-295, 321-332: invite email and team name are both required (636, 716) and the role select always has a value; there are no optional fields.
lines 636-638, 716: checks run only in the submit handlers. Lines 624, 707: the input event only clears an existing error, never sets one.

lines 286, 324, 152, 159: error paragraphs sit directly under the email and name fields. Marked beyond colour by the '! ' prefix (127) and a 2px border (98). Connection errors, tied to no field, go to the message line (656, 728).
lines 648-649: the invite email is cleared only on success; the catch branch (651-656) leaves it. Lines 726-728: a failed rename leaves the typed name in the field.
lines 619-623: fieldError sets aria-invalid and focuses the input; lines 285, 323: inputs carry aria-describedby pointing at their error paragraphs.

lines 292, 326: submit buttons are never disabled before input; 636, 716: an empty submit shows 'Enter an email address.' or 'Enter a team name.' and focuses the field. aria-disabled only during the request (428).
lines 629, 640, 711, 718, 677, 680: each submit handler returns early if the button is busy, and setBusy swaps in the busy label ('Sending invite', 'Saving name', 'Removing') until the response.
lines 640-641, 718-719, 680: buttons go busy and a status line appears synchronously. 511: select and checkbox changes show 'Saving' at once. 669: Remove opens the dialog immediately.
lines 646-650: new row appended and highlighted plus message. 691-696: row removed plus message. 518, 725: 'Saved' and 'Name saved.'. Failures are always stated (449, 526, 656, 685, 728).

lines 650, 725, 518, 696: inline status lines, no toasts. 'Invite sent to X' reports the send; 'Saved'/'Name saved.' report persistence that the unchanged control cannot show; the removal line reports an absence after the dialog closes.

lines 490-501: row errors with 'Try again' stay until Dismiss or retry. 449, 612, 703, 685: other errors are set in place and cleared only by the next attempt or edit. The only timer is the 50 ms live-region write (422).

lines 594, 748, 503-531: role and notification changes run at once with no confirmation and are reversed with the same select or checkbox. Removal is handled under FB-007 since the server cannot restore a removed member.
lines 667, 344, 347-349, 670: 'Remove X from Team?' with 'They lose access at once. You can invite them again later.', buttons 'Keep on team' and 'Remove from team', focus on 'Keep on team'.
lines 342-352, 602: the only confirmation dialog guards removing a member, which cuts access at once; rename, invite, role and notification changes have none.

lines 521-527: when a role or notification save fails, o.show(saved) puts the select or checkbox back and showError displays 'Could not change the role of X to Y.' or 'Could not turn on Z emails.' with Try again.
lines 342-352, 665-669: the single modal holds one keep-or-remove decision and opens only from the row's Remove button.

lines 669-670: native dialog.showModal() with focus set to 'Keep on team'; Escape closes unless a removal is in flight (673); native close returns focus to the Remove button, and after a removal focus goes to the Members heading (697).
lines 275-338: the Members section with invite form and table comes first under the h1; the one-field Team name form and the notification checkboxes follow, each smaller.
lines 264-275: h1 'Team settings' is followed directly by the Members section; no hero, greeting or introductory panel.
lines 278, 472: the only summary number is 'N of 12 seats used', which tells the owner whether another invite is possible (seat limit enforced by the server, handled at 475-479 and 655).
lines 304-316: the members table has no filter, search, sort or column controls.

lines 285-294, 323-328, 578, 600, 737, 347-349: all controls are native inputs, selects, checkboxes and buttons; forms submit on Enter; the dialog is native with Escape (673). No click-only custom widgets.

lines 126-127: errors are red text with a '! ' prefix; 130-131: success is green with a check mark and text; 98: invalid inputs get a thicker border plus an error message; the highlighted new row (179) is also named in the status line (650).

lines 267-268, 300-301, 329-330, 345, 354-355: role=status and role=alert regions exist in the initial markup; in-row saves and errors are sent through say() into #say and #say-now (419-423, 501, 512, 519).
lines 264-352: no accordions, disclosure buttons, custom menus, comboboxes or tabs; only native selects and one modal dialog.

lines 199-232: under 640px the invite form stacks with a full-width button and table rows become a grid with visible 'Role' and 'Last active' labels; 251: dialog max-width is 100vw minus 32px; 44-46, 122-124: controls grow to 44px.
